The '''Flip of the Credit''' was a [[Casino/Legends|casino]] owned by the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Avaro Sookcool]]. It was located in [[Equator City/Legends|Equator City]] on [[Rodia/Legends|the Rodian homeworld]].<ref name="sotesb">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> 
==History==
''Flip'' was a modest casino compared to other ones around the [[planet/Legends|planet]], and served as a front for money laundering conducted by [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]]. The rigged machines were also used to pay Black Sun [[agent/Legends|agents]] or contacts. The lounges served as syndicate meeting place, and Black Sun spies kept an eye on competitors while gambling.<ref name="sotesb" /> 

It had considerable security, as all visitors were scanned, and armed guards were wandering undercover among the customers.<ref name="sotesb" />

[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] met with Avaro here in order to solicit the criminal syndicate's aid in finding and rescuing the captured [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]. Her opinion of it was that it was a "ninth-rate, [[Insect/Legends|bug]]-chewed casino."
